<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wp_rewrite; $wp_rewrite->set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); $wp_rewrite->flush_rules();
if ( ! get_page_by_path( 'thingamablocks-demo' ) ) {
	// Demo sections (playground/demo/*.php): not part of the plugin.
	$dir = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/thingamablocks/playground/demo/';
	require_once $dir . 'functions.php';
	$render = function ( $slug ) use ( $dir ) { ob_start(); include $dir . $slug . '.php'; return ob_get_clean(); };
	$end      = ( new DateTimeImmutable( '+3 days', wp_timezone() ) )->format( 'Y-m-d\T17:00:00' );
	$content  = '';
	foreach ( array( 'table-of-contents', 'sale-banner', 'logo-marquee', 'pricing-toggle', 'launch-countdown' ) as $slug ) {
		$content .= $render( $slug ) . "\n\n";
	}
	// The demo sections have no date (the editor sets one on insert); give the demo one.
	$content = str_replace( 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {', 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '",', $content );
	$content = str_replace( 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '",}', 'wp:thingamablocks/countdown {"endDate":"' . $end . '"}', $content );
	// Saved through the content filter (kses) an Author or Contributor gets, so
	// the editor tests catch attributes it would strip.
	$id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Thingamablocks demo', 'post_name' => 'thingamablocks-demo', 'post_content' => wp_slash( $content ) ) );
	// The Downloads dropdown and share buttons are added after, unfiltered: they use
	// GenerateBlocks icons (inline SVG), which the filter strips for those
	// users on any GB button, a known GenerateBlocks limitation.
	$dropdown = array( 'content' => $render( 'downloads-dropdown' ) . "\n\n" . $render( 'share-buttons' ) );
	if ( $id ) {
		kses_remove_filters();
		wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $id, 'post_content' => wp_slash( get_post_field( 'post_content', $id ) . "\n\n" . $dropdown['content'] ) ) );
		kses_init_filters();
	}
}

<?php
// Local test site only: no GenerateBlocks Pro here, so Thingamablocks prints
// its default layout classes itself (see includes/class-thingamablocks-global-styles.php).
define( 'THINGAMABLOCKS_PRINT_DEFAULT_STYLES', true );

// Free GenerateBlocks has no {{post_content}} tag; a stand-in that, like the
// one on real sites, returns the post's raw content (FAQ schema loop test).
add_action(
	'init',
	function () {
		if ( class_exists( 'GenerateBlocks_Register_Dynamic_Tag' ) && ! isset( GenerateBlocks_Register_Dynamic_Tag::get_tags()['post_content'] ) ) {
			new GenerateBlocks_Register_Dynamic_Tag(
				array(
					'title'  => 'Post Content',
					'tag'    => 'post_content',
					'type'   => 'post',
					'return' => function () {
						return (string) get_post_field( 'post_content', get_the_ID() );
					},
				)
			);
		}
	},
	20
);

// No GenerateBlocks Pro here: register its accordion toggle and content on
// the server (rendered as saved, like GB Pro's), so the plugin's loop context
// for unique accordion IDs reaches them.
add_action(
	'init',
	function () {
		foreach ( array( 'accordion-toggle' => array( 'generateblocks/accordion/openByDefault' ), 'accordion-content' => array() ) as $part => $uses_context ) {
			if ( ! WP_Block_Type_Registry::get_instance()->is_registered( 'generateblocks-pro/' . $part ) ) {
				register_block_type( 'generateblocks-pro/' . $part, array( 'uses_context' => $uses_context ) );
			}
		}
	}
);
